text: Refines D-0266 for #545: a run's record and result pushes get through GitHub failing within the step. After any failed push, Clone.Record and Clone.Finish read the run's ref back. The commit they tried to push means success, and any other commit ends the call, with ErrRecorded for Record. Only a read showing the ref still where the push expected it, absent for Record, lets a transient failure try again: after waits of 15, 30, 60 and 120 seconds, at most five pushes of the same commit with the same force-with-lease expectation. A refusal, an unreadable or moved ref, the step's context ending, or the watcher losing its lease or tenure stops it, and exhaustion returns the last error. Each attempt checks the watcher's permission after taking the clone lock, and the waits hold neither the clone lock nor the lease lock, so renewal goes on. The shared classifier counts Git's numeric HTTP errors, fatal error in commit_refs_rules, timeouts and dropped connections as GitHub failing, and explicit refusals keep precedence. On 2026-11-04, one failed result push threw away #445's 16-minute draft.
